_comment: Project-level Claude Code settings (committed to repo). Personal/local settings live in settings.local.json (gitignored). The Stop hook below enforces the discipline that code changes should ship with matching doc updates in the same session — see docs/plan.md Phase 1.

hooks.command: if git diff --name-only HEAD 2>/dev/null | grep -qE '^(src/|docker-compose|Dockerfile|requirements)' && ! git diff --name-only HEAD 2>/dev/null | grep -qE '^(AGENTS\.md|docs/|todo)' ; then echo '⚠️  Code or infra files changed but no AGENTS.md / docs/ updates. Per the AGENTS.md convention, code changes should ship with matching doc updates. Update docs/<topic>.md, docs/todo.md, or AGENTS.md before stopping.' >&2 ; fi
